```
def maxflow_fast(nH, h_edges, others, x,y, INF):
    n = nH + len(others)
    adj=[[] for _ in n]
    to=[]; cap=[]
    for u in range(nH):
      for v,c in h_edges[u].items():
        if c>0:
          adj[u].append(len(to));to.append(v);cap.append(c if c<INF else INF)
          adj[v].append(len(to));to.append(u);cap.append(0)
    sid=nH
    for sidx,(C,V) in enumerate(others):
      s=sid+sidx
      # edge x->s cap C
      adj[x].append(len(to));to.append(s);cap.append(C); adj[s].append(len(to));to.append(x);cap.append(0)
      for v in V:
        adj[s].append(len(to));to.append(v);cap.append(INF); adj[v].append(len(to));to.append(s);cap.append(0)
```
